name: agent-watch
description: A themeable Windows home for your local coding agents.
author: William Pyle

scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs && node scripts/world-smoke.mjs && node scripts/smurfs-smoke.mjs && node scripts/borg-smoke.mjs
scripts.build: npm run themes:check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
A downloadable Borg cube built around its Queen.

- Eight distinct drone identities with 72 pose frames and a Queen with 12 frames across command, scanning, communion and mechanical reassembly.
- Inactive drones reserve a free alcove, turn outward, step backwards into it and regenerate. New work makes them step out and return to their stations.
- Sixteen regeneration alcoves with animated green strips, plasma-headpiece effects and scan lighting.
- Seventeen scenery types, four floor surfaces, 75 placed objects and 12 activities.
- Linked alcoves and home markers move together in the world editor; layouts survive theme updates.
- Declarative docking, object lighting, inactive-character routines and fixed-frame alignment are available to theme authors. Reduced motion freezes effects and skips movement.

Update the app, then open Theme library, refresh the GitHub catalog, download Borg Cube and choose Use theme. Robot Datacenter remains the included theme.

Validation: 42 unit tests plus desktop and packaged app checks covering docking, work resumption, Queen sequences, lighting pixels, layout saves, downloads and sprite transparency.

Download Agent-Watch-Setup-0.4.0-x64.exe below. Builds remain unsigned. This is an unofficial Star Trek fan theme.
